captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a custom shopping cart coin token. It has a flat, circular shape with a small off-center hole near the edge, designed for attaching to a keychain. The surface is smooth and flat, providing a robust design suitable for insertion into coin slots.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric shopping cart token coin in OpenSCAD. The script should allow customization of the coin diameter, thickness, keychain hole radius, and text engraving, with options to render only the coin (with carved-out text), only the text, or both together.
captions.factory: The design is built using a main cylinder representing the coin body. A smaller cylinder is subtracted from near the edge of the main cylinder to form the keychain hole. The script includes the 'write/Write.scad' library to generate text via the 'writecylinder' helper. Depending on the 'part' parameter, boolean 'difference' operations are used to carve the text out of the coin, or the text is rendered as a standalone or combined black overlay.
